notes.title: Isle of Maligree v3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395302/8da7652adc8aec8e40a7ec17834863f00617bb26.png[/img]
[h1]The Logbook[/h1]
[list]
[*] The logbook has been added to the main menu, letting you view what items, characters, and locations you have discovered, and which you have yet to find.
[*] The logbook contains brand new lore about locations and characters, and lets you view backgrounds you've been to in detail. 
[*] The logbook also offers some hints on where to find items if you've been to locations you can discover them in. 
[*] The logbook will fill out as you play new runs. (Old saves will automatically register items they have on them.)
[/list]
[h2]Minor Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that cause the Scrape Wound to not be marked internally as a wound.
[/list]
[h1]Final Notes[/h1]
Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far! 
Hopefully this will let you hunt down some of the trickier to discover content that might have otherwise evaded you.

All the best,
Luke from Gilded Rune Games

notes.title: Isle of Maligree v2.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395302/4c6504c3703c666aa4c75206ea350a05c461d106.png[/img]
[h1]Added new Side Stories![/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new day 1 side stories allowing players to explore different parts of the isle.
[*] Added 4 new available items that players can pick up.
[/list]

[h1]Several Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a skip button that skips all story until the next choice. (Only available after a playthrough completion)
[*] Game intro no longer plays if you have already completed a run.
[*] Inventory tutorial no longer plays if you have already completed a run.
[*] Added Dice Roll Speed setting to change the speed of the dice rolls.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Insanity effects![/h1]
[list]
[*] Added more insanity effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.5)
notes.content:
Feature Additions:
- Added "Previous Lives" screen to be able to see what paths you have taken on your previous play-throughs and what endings you have yet to find.
- Hovering over a dice dialogue option now displays your proficiency in that skill.

Fixes:
- Corrected multiple small spelling mistakes.
- Fixed a bug at character creation that caused your pronouns to always be he/him.
- Map buttons now work with controller.
